cases.title: Full agency nomination, bulk carrier loading steam coal
text: Subject: Nomination - MV SERUNI BAHARI / Mangkajang / coal loading
Good day. We, Kaldera Shipping Pte Ltd as disponent owners, hereby nominate your good office as FULL AGENT for the following call:
Vessel : MV SERUNI BAHARI (bulk carrier), IMO 9760093
ETA : {ETA.enLong}, ETD abt {ETD.enLong} subject to loading progress
Cargo : 55,000 MT steam coal in bulk, loading
Please send PDA and confirm acceptance.
Chartering & Operations | Kaldera Shipping Pte Ltd | XJW8KP
cases.authorNote: Complete nomination with name, IMO, port name+code, ETA/ETD with year and one cargo; vessel particulars are not cargo.

cases.title: Tug and barge set nominated for coal loading

cases.authorNote: Tug and barge are two vessel entries with roles stated by the labels 'Tug' and 'Tongkang'; '± 7.500 MT' is an Indonesian-format approximate quantity of 7500; 'Pelabuhan muat' makes it a LOAD.

cases.title: Formal nomination letter for urea discharge with separate billing party
text: Perihal : Nominasi Keagenan MV NUSA KAMBOJA di Pelabuhan Arun
Kami PT Tirta Agro Pelayaran selaku operator kapal menominasikan Saudara sebagai agen umum (full agency) untuk kunjungan kapal berikut:

cases.title: Owners ask for protective agency; 'would like to appoint' without formal letter
text: Subject: MV ORCHID PROSPECT – Djankar – owners' protective agency
We are the registered owners of MV ORCHID PROSPECT (IMO 9761281, call sign PLDR). Charterers have nominated their own agent at Djankar for cargo operations.
We would like to appoint you as our protective agent for this call to look after owners' matters (crew, CTM, master's cash, class survey).
Cargo: discharging 3,200 MT steel coils ex Charterers' contract
Master's cash requirement USD 15,000 – please confirm you can arrange.
cases.reviewNotes: classification: 'would like to appoint you' in an e-mail, no formal letter — nomination vs appointment genuinely ambiguous, both accepted.
cases.authorNote: Owners' protective agency explicitly requested; the charterers' agent is not a party field. Cash to master is money, not cargo.
